notes: Fixed the 'Debts Eliminated' counter at the top of the Wins tab still including balances you had moved to another card. It counted every account sitting at zero, so transfers inflated it even though the list underneath had them correctly separated. It now counts only debts you actually cleared, and says how many were moved.
Transferred balances are also no longer counted on your shareable progress cards or in celebration messages.
Fixed the win counter wrapping onto two lines mid-phrase on narrow screens.
